itemList.description: Operation and Maintenance of the scheme shall include providing the required technical staff, valve men, operators, helpers, watchman and other personnel necessary for the complete and satisfactory operation of the system, along with providing all materials and chemicals required for operation and maintenance of the Jack well, Water Treatment Plant (WTP), Pure Water Sump (PWS), pipelines and other associated components. The scope shall include regular maintenance of all civil structures such as the floating platform, WTP, PWS, Master Balancing Tank, Pump House and all other civil structures, including all kinds of repairs to damaged structures, cleaning and washing, and painting of civil structures once in two years. It shall also include necessary repairs and replacement of damaged pipelines, valves and other related components whenever required, including the cost of materials, labour charges and monitoring of the system, covering the Raw Water Rising Main, Gravity Mains and Pure Water Rising Mains, maintaining the required discharge in each pipeline, controlling all valves and ensuring that each village receives the required designed quantity of water. The operation and maintenance of the WTP shall include dosing of the required quantity of alum, chlorine and other necessary chemicals, replacement of sand or filter media as required, maintenance in accordance with established standard norms from time to time, maintaining water quality as per the CPHEEO Manual and ISI specifications, and conducting water-quality testing in a laboratory at regular intervals. The operation and maintenance shall further cover all pumping machinery and other mechanical components of the scheme, including electrical maintenance, repairs and replacement of transformers, electrical cables, switchboards, burnt machinery parts and other necessary electrical or mechanical components, and all such repairs and maintenance shall be carried out as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge to ensure satisfactory functioning of the scheme and supply of the designed LPCD of drinking water to all inhabitants of the project villages. The required staff and helpers shall be made available round the clock during the maintenance period at the Jack well, WTP and Pure Water Sump points, including helpers, watchman, valve men and technical staff. The contractor shall also maintain a Log Book regarding the working of pumping machinery at the Jack well, WTP and other relevant locations, and the Gram Panchayat or Village Water and Sanitation Committee VWSC or concerned Section Officer shall certify the satisfactory functioning of the scheme, based on which payment shall be made to the contractor. Payment shall be made by the Engineer-in-Charge based on the satisfactory report at the end of every month, and the GP Secretary and Section Officer in-charge of WSS shall provide the satisfactory functioning report.
